text:
Situation: Alprazolam 0.5 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 157 tablets at 6.2 tablets per day (25.2 days on hand). Corvale General holds 155 tablets at 7.8 tablets per day (19.8 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 44 tablets at 1.6 tablets per day (26.9 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows alprazolam is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides 19.8 to 26.9 days of supply across sites. No FDA shortage designation exists. Proactive purchasing from available suppliers is warranted to maintain buffer stock.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC (Amneal Pharmaceuticals of NY plant) as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer places orders with Par Health USA, LLC (PH HEALTH plant) as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer evaluates ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Actavis Pharma, Inc., and AvPAK for supplemental supply; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacy director reviews purchase commitments and inventory targets; requires pharmacy director approval.
5. P&T committee acknowledges supply status and purchasing plan at next meeting; requires committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
